 Va. (WSET) — Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11, and several restaurants and businesses are offering free meals and other deals to veterans and active-duty military members.
 Here are some of the offers available this year, according to the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and participating businesses:
 FOOD
 Applebee's: A free entrée from a special Veterans Day menu. The offer is dine-in only, and proof of service is required.
 Bob Evans: A free meal from a special Veterans Day menu. The offer is dine-in only, and a valid service ID is required.
 Bonefish Grill: A free Bang Bang Shrimp entrée and a nonalcoholic beverage for veterans, active-duty military members and their families.
 Chili's: A free entrée from a select Veterans Day menu at participating locations. The offer is dine-in only, and ID is required.
 Chipotle: Free chips and a choice of guacamole, queso blanco or salsa with a $5 purchase at participating locations. ID is required.
 Firehouse Subs: Offers veterans and active-duty military members a buy-one-get-one-free sub with a valid military ID. The offer is available in-store at participating locations.
 Denny's: A free Original Grand Slam from 5 a.m. to noon. The offer is dine-in only, and ID is required.
 Golden Corral: A free buffet and beverage for current service members, retired military and veterans during its annual Military Appreciation Night. The offer is dine-in only and runs from 4 p.m. until closing.
 Red Lobster: A free Shrimp and Chips meal for veterans, active-duty military members and reservists. The offer is dine-in only, and ID is required.
 Red Robin: A free Red's Big Tavern Burger with bottomless steak fries. The offer is dine-in only, and ID is required.
 Ruby Tuesday: A free Everyday Fresh Meal valued at up to $17.99, including a choice of one of 13 entrées, the Garden Bar and a bottomless drink. The offer also includes Reserve and National Guard members. Dine-in only; proof of service required.
 Starbucks: A free 12-ounce hot or iced brewed coffee for veterans, active-duty military members and military spouses at participating locations.
 Texas Roadhouse: Free meals for veterans and active-duty military members. Customers should check with their local restaurant for participation details.
 OTHER DEALS
 Great Clips: Offers veterans and active-duty service members a free haircut. Customers can also request a free haircut card to give to a veteran.
 Rack Room Shoes: Offers 20% off in-store purchases for military members, veterans and their families with valid military identification.
 Sport Clips: Participating locations offer free or discounted haircuts to veterans and active-duty service members.
 Target: Offers 20% off one qualifying purchase for verified military members, veterans and eligible family members enrolled in Target Circle Military Appreciation.
 ZIPS Car Wash: Offers veterans and active-duty military members a free top-tier car wash at participating locations.
 Offers may vary by location and are subject to change. Proof of military service may be required.
